jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity:**

  

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Onboarding & Implementation**

* Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.
* Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.
* Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.
* Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.
* Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

**Client Experience**

* Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.
* Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.
* Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.
* Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.
* Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.
* Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.
* Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

**Process Improvement & Enablement**

* Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.
* Create client-facing onboarding materials and training guides built around multifamily workflows.
* Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.
* Act as the team’s subject matter expert on onboarding, sharing best practices with Client Success team members.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

In your first year, success means:

* New properties go live on schedule, meet SLAs, and start with strong satisfaction and health scores.
* The playbooks, SOPs, and automations you build are adopted across Client Services.
* You resolve complex, multi-property launch issues on your own and keep internal teams on track through tight timelines.
* Teammates count on you as a go-to resource for onboarding.

### **What You'll Need:**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in client onboarding or implementation at a B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services company.
* A track record of leading enterprise or multi-location rollouts from handoff to adoption, including building the playbooks and SOPs behind them.
* Experience coordinating software integrations or data migrations with clients and technical teams.
* Strong organization. You can manage dozens of rollouts at once without letting quality slip, and you use data to spot and fix problems.
* Clear communication, from presenting to executives to explaining complex workflows to non-technical staff.
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing tools, plus hands-on experience with CRM, project management, and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Kustomer).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multifamily real estate experience, whether in onsite or regional property operations (e.g., Community Manager) or at a PropTech vendor, ideally with NMHC Top 50 owners/operators.
* Experience with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, AppFolio, or ResMan.
* Experience with Salesforce Flow or custom intake forms.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Communications, or a related field.

**Core Competency Profile**

* **Project Management:** Highly organized with superior attention to detail; capable of managing dozens of simultaneous property rollouts without sacrificing quality.
* **Customer-Centric Leadership:** Empathetic listener and skilled communicator capable of simplifying complex workflows for non-technical property staff.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Able to navigate ambiguity, overcome technical blockers, and build constructive relationships across diverse internal and external stakeholders.

### **What We'll Deliver On:**

  

* Competitive base salary plus performance bonus potential
* Flexible work schedule with eligibility to work remotely
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Unlimited vacation
  

At Fetch, we are always looking for awesome people to join our growing team. If you think you’re the right fit for this position, apply today. We’d love to hear from you!

*Fetch is an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will be considered without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, disabilities, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

The Implementation Specialist supports the successful deployment of new platforms, processes, and operating models across the organization. Partners with business teams, Product, Technology, Training, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate implementation activities from readiness and launch through hyper care, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. Provides structure and visibility across complex implementations by monitoring progress, identifying risks and dependencies, facilitating issue resolution, and supporting data-informed decision-making. Contributes to consistent, scalable implementation practices and continuous improvement across future rollouts.

**HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE**

* Coordinates implementation activities across the lifecycle, including readiness, launch, hyper care, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations.
* Partners with business and technical teams to align implementation plans, activities, dependencies, milestones, and responsibilities.
* Maintains implementation plans, playbooks, tools, documentation, and established readiness and transition criteria.
* Establishes and supports cross-functional operating cadences for implementation coordination, issue resolution, escalation, and decision-making.
* Identifies and tracks risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies; ensures appropriate ownership, action planning, escalation, and follow-through.
* Monitors implementation, adoption, support, and operational performance indicators to assess rollout health and identify emerging concerns.
* Synthesizes operational data, stakeholder feedback, and implementation observations to identify trends and areas requiring attention.
* Develops concise status reporting that provides stakeholders and leaders visibility into implementation progress, risks, issues, trends, and required decisions.
* Facilitates cross-functional problem solving and coordinates timely communication of critical information to appropriate stakeholders.
* Captures lessons learned and identifies opportunities to improve and standardize implementation processes, tools, and practices across future rollout activities.
* Other duties as assigned

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

Required Education, Experience, Certification/Licensure

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Typically have 4+ years of related experience.
* Experience in implementation, program or project management, business operations, operational readiness, deployment, or a related field.
* Experience coordinating complex initiatives across multiple business and technical teams.
* Experience identifying and managing project or implementation risks, issues, dependencies, actions, and escalations.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology, platform, process, or operating-model implementations preferred.
* Experience with go-live, hyper care, stabilization, adoption, or large-scale implementation activities preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)**

* Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, activities, and dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate information into action.
* Ability to synthesize complex information and communicate key findings, risks, and priorities clearly to different audiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build effective cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Ability to identify risks and issues proactively and facilitate appropriate resolution and escalation.
* Knowledge of implementation, operational readiness, adoption, and stabilization practices.
* Familiarity with dashboards, key performance indicators, and operational performance reporting.
* Ability to work effectively across business, Product, Technology, Support, Training, and Change Management functions.
* Ability to adapt and remain effective in fast-paced, evolving environments.

  
Pay Range: $85,000.00 - $113,300.00 Annually  
This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

**\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\***

First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act).

First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements.

**What We Offer**
=================

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.description:
**Healthcare Software Implementation Specialist – 100% Remote**

  

At RAM Health, our mission is to simplify the complexities of healthcare administration through innovative, technology-driven solutions. With a focus on changing the industry one plan at a time, we drive continuous innovation to help government-sponsored health plans improve performance and quality while reducing costs.

RAM Health - Health plan administration, simplified.

  

This position is 100% remote and allows you to live anywhere in the U.S. and work from your home office. RAM does not provide sponsorship for U.S. employment and candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. All work must be done within the U.S.

  

Working as part of the Client Support team, the Implementation Specialist has the ability to forge strong customer relations, evaluate client requirements and develop configurations that support business processes.

  

**Responsibilities of an Implementation Specialist:**

* Define and execute implementation plans.
* Test and troubleshoot final system configuration.
* Provide training and end-user support during and after the implementation process.
* May be involved in pre-sales product demonstrations.
* Analyze client data to assist clients with configuration issues.
* Create and run database queries to evaluate data.
* Configure and test within the system to make recommendations to clients.
* Identify and facilitate issue resolution with functional and technical groups.

  

**Requirements of an Implementation Specialist:**

* Strong reading comprehension, writing and presentation skills.
* 2-4 years of related health care or software implementation experience.
* Bachelor's degree with a focus in Management Information Systems or Health Care is preferred or equivalent experience is required.
* Knowledge of the healthcare industry and/or working experience with technology (i.e. UNIX, SQL, etc.) is a plus.
* Ability to work independently.
* Occasional travel may be required in the future.

  

The Implementation Specialist offers a salary range of $80,000 to $90,000 commensurate with experience and an excellent benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, life insurance, STD, LTD, 5 weeks' vacation, and paid holidays.

**Compliance:** All employees shall comply with company policies, including those related to security and privacy, as well as with applicable laws and regulations such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health (HITECH) Act, and other relevant federal and state regulations.

  

**Data Protection:** Employees are responsible for safeguarding protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in accordance with company policies and HIPAA regulations. This includes ensuring that all data is accessed, processed, stored, and transmitted securely.

Note: This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not an exhaustive list of efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with it. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Integration Analyst, Implementation
jobs.description:
Are you seeking an exciting opportunity to join a passionate, growing, and dynamic team of professionals who support patients?

The Integration Analyst, Implementation is responsible for contributing to the success of Knowtion Health solutions and services at client health systems. This role oversees certain aspects of solution implementations and post-go live stabilization, including but not limited to data acquisition and validation, client-facing and internal communication, solution data specification maintenance and optimization, and data-related risk management to ensure timely solution delivery and alignment with client expectations and organizational standards.

**What’s Attractive to the Right Candidate?**

* Knowtion Health is a growing firm in a growing industry. Our status as a leader in this industry means that we have the resources to invest in the business and to innovate.
* Our business is intensely competitive and is constantly evolving. We quickly identify new challenges and develop solutions, so you won’t simply be doing what was done last year. Our new employees are frequently pleased and surprised by how quickly we make decisions and adapt to market conditions.
* Knowtion Health culture is inviting and competitive, embracing challenge and celebrating accomplishment; dedicated colleagues striving to provide quality results that have lasting impact.

**The Opportunity:**

* Develop and maintain standard operating procedure (SOP) to support scalable and timely approach to data acquisition and validation.
* Assist Implementation Managers on multiple concurrent client implementation projects, ensuring timely progress and clear communication across internal and external stakeholders.
* Apply industry and Knowtion Health best practices in collaboration with team Managers and fellow Analysts.
* Resolve technical project roadblocks to ensure successful outcomes.
* Participate in and facilitate internal and external project meetings, including scheduling, agenda creation, note-taking, and distribution of meeting minutes.
* Document workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all new client and program implementations.
* Oversee the setup of automated and ad hoc file exchanges between clients and Knowtion Health per project specifications.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience
* 1+ years working for a healthcare or revenue cycle organization
* 1+ years in client-facing, technology-driven implementation or business analyst roles.
* 1+ years working specifically with standardized healthcare claims and remit data (837I, 837P, 835) and familiarity with working with non-standard custom revenue cycle extracts (transaction and account files for example).
* Experience writing, QA’ing, and explaining SQL queries to generate custom reports and support product-related development efforts.
* Proficiency with Business Intelligence (BI) tools

The above statements are intended to provide the general nature and level of work being performed by most people assigned to the position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and requirements.

This position is remote and requires a dedicated, distraction-free work space at home. We offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, paid holidays, 401k, and a generous PTO policy.

Knowtion Health gives priority to applicants located in the following states: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, ME, MI, MO, MS, NC, NM, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WI, WV

**Photo Identification and Image Capture Notice**

As part of our hiring process, candidates are required to present a valid government-issued photo ID during screening and/or interviews.

We may also capture a photograph during the screening or interview process for identity verification, security, and record-keeping purposes. All identification documents and images will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and accessed only by authorized personnel.

By proceeding with your application, you acknowledge and consent to this process.

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Strongpoint Partners is tech-enabled retirement services platform serving small- to mid-sized businesses with integrated retirement third party administration, recordkeeping, payroll, and HR solutions. Recognized as one of Inc. 5000's Fastest Growing Private Companies in America and certified as a Great Place to Work, Strongpoint offers a suite of services that prioritizes accuracy, compliance, and reduction of regulatory risk for its clients, delivered by local client success teams that understand the nuances of the markets they serve. Strongpoint Partners combines a relentless passion for service and innovation with the experience and expertise required to make retirement work for everyone. For more information, please visit: www.strongpointpartners.com.

**Retirement Plan Documentation & Onboarding Specialist**
=========================================================

### **About Strongpoint Partners**

Strongpoint Partners is a leading provider of retirement plan administration, recordkeeping, and consulting services. Through our network of specialized partner firms, we deliver personalized retirement solutions and exceptional service to clients nationwide.

### **Position Summary**

BCS, a Strongpoint Partners company, is seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Retirement Plan Documentation & Onboarding Specialist** to join our team. In this role, you will support the preparation, review, and coordination of retirement plan documents while helping ensure a smooth and efficient onboarding experience for new clients.

The ideal candidate has experience in retirement plan administration, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while collaborating with clients, advisors, and internal teams. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to process improvements and support the continued growth of our retirement services business.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare, review, and coordinate retirement plan documents, including adoption agreements, plan documents, trust agreements, and related materials.
* Manage new client onboarding workflows from initial document preparation through execution and implementation.
* Review documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable IRS, ERISA, and internal requirements.
* Collaborate with clients, financial advisors, custodians, and internal teams to gather necessary information and ensure timely onboarding.
* Conduct detailed quality reviews, identifying and resolving discrepancies or missing information before documents are finalized.
* Coordinate new retirement plan setup, custodian alignment, and implementation activities.
* Maintain accurate digital records, track documentation progress, and update client and plan information across internal systems.
* Monitor onboarding timelines and communicate updates to relevant stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to streamline documentation processes, improve workflows, and increase operational efficiency.
* Stay informed of regulatory and industry changes affecting retirement plan documentation and administration.
* Work collaboratively across teams and Strongpoint partner organizations to deliver a consistent, high-quality client experience.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* Experience in retirement plan administration, plan documentation, or client onboarding preferred.
* Familiarity with qualified retirement plans, including 401(k), profit-sharing, and other defined contribution plans.
* General understanding of IRS and ERISA regulations related to retirement plan documentation.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to learn new software and internal systems.
* Experience with retirement plan administration software and document management systems preferred.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative, client-focused approach.
* Experience with SAGE software and additional language proficiency are a plus.

### **Why Join Strongpoint Partners?**

At Strongpoint Partners, you'll be part of a growing organization committed to delivering exceptional retirement plan services. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development, providing opportunities to expand your expertise while making a meaningful impact on our clients and teams.

**Our Value-Driven Employee Experience:**

* **Flexible Workplace** – Hybrid and remote options available for many roles.
* **Flexible PTO** – Competitive paid time off, including flexible & unlimited options.
* **Inclusive Environment** – A culture that values diversity, collaboration, and respect.
* **Growth Opportunities** – Support for ongoing learning and career development.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Health, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
* **Workplace Perks** – Incentive bonus programs, flexible hours, & more.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist - Part Time
jobs.description:
Under general supervision of the HR Manager and Recruiting Supervisor, the Onboarding Specialist (OS) will provide administrative support to the Recruiters on the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC) in Centennial, CO. The OS will contribute to the overall success of the Recruiting Group by providing instruction and support to candidates preparing to deploy for contract work in Antarctica while assuring a high level of customer service and maintaining quality throughout the staffing process. During the peak periods, will be responsible for managing 200+ candidates.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for onboarding of all assigned candidates: collecting and processing of HR paperwork and guiding candidates through the Physical Qualification (PQ) process for deployment; administer background and drug screenings
* Make initial determinations and recommendations on candidate background and drug screenings; follow-up with candidates to obtain supporting documentation for employment and education verification; present supplemental documentation for background screenings to the Recruiter for final approval
* Provide frequent instruction, support, and pertinent pre-deployment details to candidates: assist in scheduling and billing of PQ appointments, communicate important timelines and deadlines for progressing through the process up until deployment
* Accurately submit and maintain participant files within the Pipeline database; regularly track changes in medical/deployment status and communicate to the appropriate parties
* Correspond with candidates via phone and email on a daily basis to ensure proper submission of required documents and overall engagement with on-boarding procedures; send, receive, and track employment documents via email, fax and overnight mail
* Maintain accurate staffing updates within daily reports and Excel spreadsheets
* Collect and review candidate expense reimbursement requests to ensure accuracy and compliance with PAE reimbursement policies; may assist with setting up direct bill options for candidates to complete the PQ process
* Works closely with the ASC Travel Department when making decisions about ticketing candidates: regularly exercises independent judgment when deciding if a candidate’s scheduled flight should be adjusted due to outstanding PQ/HR requirements.
* Works closely with the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) to help facilitate questions for candidates and PQ status updates; decide which candidates are high priority and provide a weekly status report to UTMB.
* Provide guidance to candidates on program and company policies; may assist with providing ASC Program overview for new hires
* Responsible for managing confidential information to include background, medical, banking and other pre-employment paperwork.
* Acts as a continued resource once candidates are hired to answer questions, help mitigate grievances and concerns that are brought forth.
* Responsible for identifying potential concerns and “red flags” in candidates that are working through the onboarding process; document concerns and provide detailed and accurate statements to both the Recruiter and Hiring Manager for further investigation.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:**

* High school diploma or GED
* Minimum two (2) years of prior administrative experience within a high volume, fast paced customer service environment

**Expected Skills and Competencies:**

* Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills, including phone and email etiquette
* Must be detail oriented with excellent time management skills; able to maintain confidentiality as appropriate
* A great team attitude and ability to work harmoniously with others
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, MS Excel, MS Word, and Adobe Acrobat Pro, as well as utilizing various internet search functions.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in maintaining information in an Applicant Tracking System or other database
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience

**Physical and/or Other Requirements**:

* Successful completion of federal background check required by the NSF

**Compensation Details:**

$20.00

jobs.description:
**Vice President, Customer Onboarding and Professional Services**
=================================================================

### **Who We Are**

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is a Vertical AI company built for the utility industry, delivering appliance-level intelligence for every customer, grid asset, and hour of the year through our UtilityAI Platform. We're accelerating a clean energy future by giving utilities and their customers the ability to make smarter, data-driven energy decisions.

Bidgely's platform is connected to 50M+ meters across over 50 utility deployments and is backed by over 20 patents. Our approach combines patented disaggregation science, generative AI for natural-language insight, and agentic AI for autonomous operations — giving utilities a level of individual-customer intelligence and grid insights that horizontal AI and legacy analytics platforms can't match.

Bidgely has been named #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company's list of Most Innovative Companies in the World and recognized as a Utility Analytics Leader by Guidehouse.

### **What We Do**

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI Platform transforms multiple dimensions of utility data — such as energy consumption, demographics, and customer interactions — into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

The same technology that powers Bidgely's customer suite also enables a set of powerful grid applications. From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is accelerating utility innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, load forecasting, grid analytics, and rate designs. Bidgely's UtilityAI energy analytics platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

### **How You Fit In**

The Vice President, Customer Onboarding and Professional Services leads Bidgely's global consulting organization — a team of 40+ professionals who bring the UtilityAI Platform to life for utilities around the world. This leader owns the full services lifecycle: from contracting and onboarding, through implementation and launch, to the ongoing professional services that help live customers expand their programs and realize more value over time. The role reports to the Chief Operating Officer and serves as a member of Bidgely's senior leadership team.

The organization includes the VP of Global Delivery, the Director of Project Management, Technical Program Managers, Solution Architects, and Delivery Consultants. Together, this team blends deep technical, functional, and program management expertise to deliver complex, high-impact programs for some of the largest utilities in the world.

Bidgely's platform and our customers' needs are evolving quickly. Generative and agentic AI, new grid and distributed energy resources (DER) infrastructure use cases, and an expanding product portfolio are opening new opportunities for utilities — and raising the bar for how quickly and robustly value is delivered. The VP will lead the next stage of the services organization's growth: further scaling and productizing how we deliver, developing the team and leaders who will carry Bidgely forward, and making every engagement a showcase for Bidgely as the trusted AI partner to the utility industry.

Core responsibilities span the following areas:

**Organizational Leadership & Talent**

* Lead, develop, and inspire a 40+ person organization spanning delivery, program management, solution architecture, and consulting
* Build a strong team and client-centric culture grounded in ownership, technical excellence, collaboration, and a shared commitment to customer outcomes
* Design the organizational structure, roles, and career paths that allow the team to scale alongside Bidgely's growth
* Attract, hire, and retain top talent, and build a deep bench of next-generation services leaders
* Set clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans across the organization, and coach leaders to do the same

**Services Evolution & Delivery Excellence**

* Set the vision and multi-year strategy for Bidgely's services organization, aligned with company goals, product direction, and the evolving needs of the utility market
* Scale and productize delivery through repeatable, packaged implementation offerings, reusable assets, and AI-enabled tooling that accelerate time-to-value for every customer
* Own Bidgely's implementation methodology, delivery playbooks, quality standards, and governance framework, evolving them continuously as products and customer needs change
* Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, and Data Engineering so every launch is coordinated, well-governed, and set up for success from day one
* Define and track the KPIs that matter — time-to-value, delivery quality, customer satisfaction, utilization, and margin — and use them to drive continuous improvement
* Champion AI and automation within the services organization to increase speed, consistency, and scale

**Financial Management**

* Own the full services P&L, including contracting and revenue forecasting, gross margin, utilization, and cost management
* Lead resource and capacity planning to align talent, skills, and staffing with the project pipeline and company growth plans
* Partner with Sales and Finance to set standards for services scoping, pricing, statements of work, and change orders
* Develop packaged services offerings and pricing models that create value for customers and support profitable growth. Report services performance, forecasts, and investment priorities to the COO and executive leadership

**Executive Engagement**

jobs.description:
StudioBinder builds production management software used by agencies and creative teams to run their entire production workflow: crew and talent, scheduling, script breakdowns, shot lists, storyboards, media, and call sheets, backed by a blog reaching 1M+ monthly readers and a YouTube channel with 2M+ subscribers.

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success & Onboarding Specialist to own the full post-sale customer relationship, not just the first 30 days. This role owns onboarding end to end, verifies customers are actually adopting the platform, runs ongoing check-ins throughout the account lifecycle, manages renewals, and identifies expansion opportunities to hand back to sales. You'll also represent StudioBinder at industry trade shows alongside our sales team and be a visible face of the brand: on camera in support and product videos, and in person at events. This isn't a surface-level relationship role: you'll need to know the product inside and out, be genuinely comfortable diagnosing and clearly documenting bugs, and help test new releases before they ship.

Visit our Careers page (www.studiobinder.com/careers) to learn about our work culture, benefits, and a typical day.

Job Responsibilities:

* Own the customer relationship end to end: onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion, not just the initial ramp
* Develop true expert-level fluency with every StudioBinder feature, the person other reps and even the product team turn to when a workflow question comes up
* Investigate and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, file tickets, track them through to resolution, and rigorously test upcoming releases before they ship
* Onboard new customers and proactively guide them to value in their first weeks
* Run ongoing check-ins throughout the customer lifecycle to confirm real platform adoption, not just completed setup
* Own the renewals process for your accounts and flag at-risk accounts early
* Identify expansion opportunities during check-ins and hand qualified accounts to sales

* Represent StudioBinder at trade shows and industry events in and around Los Angeles, supporting our sales team on-site
* Write, film, and edit support and product videos, including on-screen appearances, plus write help documentation and tutorials
* Help train and refine our Intercom Fin AI assistant based on real customer conversations
* Respond to live chat and email support inquiries quickly and effectively
* Identify patterns in customer questions and relay insights to product, engineering, and content teams
* Balance reactive support (heaviest early in the week) against onboarding, renewals, documentation, and event work

Requirements:

* 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or technical support, ideally including renewals ownership
* Genuinely technical: comfortable digging into how the product actually works, reproducing and clearly documenting bugs, and building expert-level fluency with a complex SaaS tool, not just surface-level familiarity

The Specialist serves as a subject matter expert and escalation point, ensuring timely resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.  
  
II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Act as the primary contact for escalated service issues from internal teams, including Sales, Customer Experience, and Operations, across multiple communication channels (phone, email, chat, and case management systems).
* Analyze and resolve complex service disruptions by coordinating with dispatch, site leadership, and cross-functional teams to implement timely and effective solutions.
* Manage a high volume of escalations independently, prioritizing cases based on urgency and business impact.
* Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of all escalation cases, tracking trends and contributing to process improvement initiatives.

III. Qualifications
  
  
A. Required Qualifications

* High School Diploma or G.E.D.
* 3 years of relevant work experience with working in a team setting, with the ability to communicate to several areas effectively and
* 3 years Multi-tasking in a fast-paced work environment with excellent organizational skills.
* Experience working cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve service issues.

B. Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree (accredited)
* Familiarity with CRM and case management tools (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow).

IV. Physical Requirements  
  
Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

The expected base pay rate for this Remote position is **$24.47-$41.40.** This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific salary offered to a successful candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including the candidate’s relevant experience, education, training, certifications, qualifications, and work location.  
  
V. Benefits
  
At WM, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term disability. In addition, we offer a stock purchase plan, company matching on a 401(k), and more. Employees also receive paid vacation, holidays, and personal days. Please note that benefits may vary by site.

jobs.title: Acumatica Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**  
  
Accordant Company, LLC is seeking an **Acumatica Implementation Lead** to join our growing, fully remote team. We are looking for talented individuals who are knowledgeable in our industry, professional in their client interactions, and excited to thrive in a fast-growing company. The Acumatica Implementation Lead will play a critical role in guiding clients through the implementation of Acumatica solutions, ensuring the successful deployment of core financial modules, delivering end-user training, and strengthening our Acumatica practice.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead Acumatica system implementations ensuring timely delivery and high client satisfaction.

* Provide comprehensive end-user training and ongoing support post-implementation.

* Collaborate closely with clients, understanding their needs and ensuring all aspects of the system align with their financial workflows.

* Drive the growth of our Acumatica practice, bringing enthusiasm and determination to every project.

* Effectively communicate and share Acumatica knowledge within the team, fostering a learning environment.

* Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and integration within the Acumatica platform.

* Managing, train, and mentor one dedicated implementation support consultant who will assist with project rollout.

* Manage 4-6 projects concurrently.

* Maintain a minimum billable utilization of 25-30 hours.

  

**Skills Required:**

* Ability to build an Acumatica environment from the ground up.

* Successfully completed 10+ Acumatica implementations.

* 2+ years of experience in Acumatica implementation as a consultant.

* Proficiency with core financial modules within Acumatica.

* Acumatica Implementation Specialist certification.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable in client-facing roles.
* Proven track record of building successful relationships with clients and team members.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a remote environment.  

**Additional Preferred Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance.

* Public accounting experience.

  

Always Choose Exceptional | Lead with Integrity | Embody Respect and Care Deeply | Embrace Change and Innovation

**Note:** Candidates must be authorized to work in the US or Canada; we cannot provide sponsorship at this time.
